title: Ran 575 connects with 2,975 colleague touchpoints in 2021
summary: In 2021 I ran 575 program connects over 448 hours, with 2,975 colleague touchpoints across Bengaluru, Eindhoven and other sites. I also conducted 24 interviews for the team.
the_call: Keep treating outreach as a measured program.
what_i_did: Designed, tracked and ran every connect.
what_changed: 575 connects, 448 hours, 2,975 touchpoints, 24 interviews and 36 observation sessions.
